commit_message: Preserve project config API for ADR 0117
pr_title: Implement ADR 0117 project-first Launcher and Editor lifecycle
pr_body: Follow-up for ADR 0117: preserve ProjectConfig's existing public struct-literal API by moving ProjectId and engine association into persisted ProjectRoot identity, remove the obsolete Hub module after recents moved to Launcher, and fix lifecycle lease tests. Re-run full Windows validation.
